text: The designmode.css landing removes the single obsolete resource entry and cites the Gecko removal revision. The accepted manifest keeps EditorOverride.css and contenteditable.css without designmode.css. When an upstream resource is retired, review the owned package manifest as a separate integration boundary. No upstream patch or failed packaging log was read, so the cited removal is commit-reported context rather than a diagnosed build failure. This is static source evidence. No runtime, build or accessibility session was run. Full bug and review discussion remains pending.
title: Remove obsolete upstream resources from the Thunderbird package manifest
